reply_text:
The depot was Southgate. I've posted that as a reply to your message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

It comes from the outage messages in that channel, which you're a member of. On 3 Sep 2025, while label printing was stalled, Pree said Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her 18:43 update that day said Southgate had cleared the backlog. The channel doesn't give a city or address for Southgate, so if you need one, Pree or Hollis would know.

I left out an email I found about the same outage. You can't see it, and it describes a different problem at another Tansley site, so it doesn't change the answer.
